moments.author: Deadline
moments.quote: EXCLUSIVE: In its first 24 hours, the last #AvengersDoomsday trailer racked up 563 million views, making it the most viewed Disney trailer of all‑time; 2nd most viewed of all time.
moments.why: It broke records, becoming Disney’s most‑viewed trailer ever and the second‑most‑viewed overall, generating huge social buzz.

moments.author: Essence Festival Official (via Axios)
moments.quote: Essence Fest will not be held in New Orleans next year, organizers say, amid stalled contract negotiations and talks with other cities.
moments.why: The announcement surprised fans and the city alike by ending a three‑decade tradition in New Orleans.

moments.author: ABC7 New York
moments.quote: The parade is expected to begin dry Thursday morning, but strong winds could be a major concern… rain is expected by late morning, with the worst arriving afternoon and evening — winds may exceed balloon safety thresholds.
moments.why: It went viral as it directly addressed storm threats to the iconic Macy’s parade balloons and holiday plans.
